usageNote: 超经典的自我介绍句！hobby就是业余爱好，说这句话显得你有品位又有趣，聊天必备！

examples.en: Music has always been a hobby of mine, so I spend weekends playing guitar.
examples.zh: 音乐一直是我的爱好，所以我周末都在弹吉他。

examples.en: She said music has always been a hobby, but now she performs professionally.
examples.zh: 她说音乐一直是她的爱好，但现在她已经专业演出了。
